# Active_Inference_Agent

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An agent that minimizes variational free energy by actively sampling its environment, using a generative model with perspective latents to guide action selection. Bridges cognitive modeling with network architectures, enabling adaptive and self-organizing behavior in iNEST neuromorphic systems.
